paper.title_en: Integrable mass of Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson black hole
paper.abstract_en: The nontrivial asymptotic structure of rotating black holes in the Bertotti-Robinson universe complicates a direct determination of their conserved mass, leading previous studies to rely on a priori thermodynamic input. We address this long-standing problem using integrability methods, establish local analytic existence and uniqueness via the Cauchy-Kovalevskaja theorem, and obtain a closed expression via a rescaled recurrence whose termination is proved at all orders. The resulting Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson mass coincides with the expression previously derived using the canonical first law identity and reproduces the masses of both Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson subcases. With the mass thus fixed without invoking thermodynamic relations for the first time, we rigorously establish the first law of black-hole thermodynamics and the Smarr formula for a whole family of Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson black holes suitable for future applications.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文针对Bertotti-Robinson宇宙中旋转黑洞质量定义的长期难题，采用可积性与Cauchy-Kovalevskaja定理给出局部解析存在唯一性，并证明递推在任意阶终止以获得闭式质量表达式；在不依赖热力学关系的前提下严格建立黑洞热力学第一定律与Smarr公式，理论深度与方法严谨性信号较强，值得进一步阅读。
decision.abstract_zh: Bertotti-Robinson宇宙中旋转黑洞的非平凡渐近结构使得直接确定其守恒质量变得复杂，导致此前的研究依赖于先验的热力学输入。我们运用可积方法处理这一长期存在的问题，通过Cauchy-Kovalevskaja定理建立局部解析存在性与唯一性，并借助一个经缩放的重现（递推）获得闭式表达式，其终止性在任意阶均被证明。所得的Kerr-Newman-Bertotti-Robinson质量与先前利用正则第一定律恒等式导出的表达式一致，并重现了Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson两个子情形的质量。在首次不引入热力学关系而如此确定质量之后，我们严格建立了一整族Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson黑洞的黑洞热力学第一定律与Smarr公式，适合未来应用。
